caption: The drawing depicts a single ornamental object centrally positioned on a plain, light beige background. The object appears to be a decorative wooden carving with a design that combines a stylized animal head at the top—featuring an eye, snout, and mouth—connected to a scroll and acanthus leaf motif below. The carving is rendered in shades of brown and beige, with darker lines and shading used to indicate depth, wood grain, and texture. The edges and contours are smoothly curved, and the lower section consists of overlapping, flowing leaf shapes and a spiraling scroll element. The composition is minimal, with no additional objects or background details, and the focus remains solely on the ornamental carving.
title: Wood Carving - Profile Face
